notes.split_counts: exactly 8 vignettes with split=dev and 16 with split=test, checked by score_v2.py at load time, not expressible in this schema draft without a separate counting tool
notes.id_uniqueness: every vignette id must be unique, also checked by score_v2.py at load time
notes.why_not_cases_v2_json: the original plan for this eval rebuild was an empty eval/cases.v2.json scaffold with all five condition fields left blank for a human to fill in later under a no-LLM-writes-the-phrasings rule. That plan was superseded mid-build: eval/vignettes.v2.json was authored and committed directly by the project owner's own process, with provenance.human_authored set to false. This schema was updated to describe the file that actually exists rather than the file that was originally planned. See eval/README.md for the full account of that change and eval/PREREGISTRATION.md for what was locked in before it happened.
